description: Woman on horse trough the woods. She is riding over a frozen sand path in the woods. The horse hesitates in the beginning because it has to pass the microphone standing there. Nice to hear the cracking of the saddle and the nervous sniffing of the horse. Two great spotted woodpeckers give there nervous call as well. This is a small part of a long wood soundscape : http://www.freesound.org/people/klankbeeld/sounds/178136/ If any of these sounds have been of help, and you are feeling charitable, please do consider donating to Freesound to help keep the site running (a link is also on the home page). Any donations are greatly appreciated! YOU ALWAYS HAVE TO CREDIT/ATTRIBUTE me (klankbeeld) and freesound.org in your work if you use this sound.
